voidvanguards.vanguard.name: Vanguard
voidvanguards.voidborn.name: Voidborn
voidvanguards.message.skyship.entered_or: You receive a glimps of something high above, it seems to be in a stable orbit around the world.
Maybe you could look at it closer with a spyglass?
voidvanguards.message.skyship.left_orbit: Everything feels normal again. The object must have left its orbit.
voidvanguards.message.skyship.more_detai: The closer you look at the ship, the more details are revealed.
voidvanguards.message.skyship.lost_focus: As you lose focus of the sky ship, the details have been lost.
voidvanguards.message.skyship.explosion: You suddenly see an explosion of energy eminating from the ship!
voidvanguards.message.skyship.server_tri: %s has witnessed an explosion in the sky!
voidvanguards.message.skyship.reset: Sky ship visibility has been reset.
voidvanguards.message.vanguards.cosmos.i: We have been observing your activity from orbit and are aware that you have noticed us.
Oh that explosion? Don't worry, we all made it out safely. But it's one of the reasons you're here.
You are in our headquarters, a couple of light-minutes away from the place you call home.
But an introduction might be in order.
We are the Vanguards. Explorers of realms and void. Defenders of time and space.
The explosion you witnessed was part of the ongoing effort from our adversaries to destroy us.
It did not work, as you can see, but the %s will not stop until we have seized to exist.
What we need from you is to...
voidvanguards.message.vanguards.home.ini: You look around. You're back where you were before.
voidvanguards.message.vanguards.radio.in: I'm glad I was able to get you away from the station.
We were attacked. It has been rough..
Time moves differently in the cosmos. A week has passed since we met.
There are.. less of us now. We were able to bury our dead.
I have a favour to ask.
We've detected a forwarding base operated by supporters of %s.
I can't risk teleporting again until that base is inoperable.
When you are ready, go to these coordinates:
Enter the portal. Destroy the radar on the edge of the base.
Be careful. I will see you once the mission is complete.
voidvanguards.message.vanguards.radio.co: You must destroy the base located at:
voidvanguards.message.vanguards.voidborn: With the radar destroyed, we were able to penetrate %s's defenses.
I'm glad you didn't fall for their false promises.
This has been an enormously important step in halting their advance of eternal darkness.
We'll handle things from here, I’m sending you back to the cosmos portal.
Thank you for your bravery, I will contact you soon.
You've done us and the world a great service.
With the %s threat taken care of, for now, we're moving on to a different quadrant.
I'd like to give you this:
It grants you the ability to teleport between this planet and the Vanguard Station at will.
Remodel it if you like, but keep it functional. We might need it again.
Good luck on your future ventures.
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.initial.2: You have proven that you are capable enough.
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.initial.4: We are born from the void, and will rise again.
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.initial.5: However, if we can come to a certain agreement, we can both benefit from this situation.
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.initial.6: I can sense traces of an Orbital Radio on you.
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.initial.7: With that, I can track the Vanguard's location.
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.initial.8: ...and we can get rid of them.
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.initial.9: This base, the asteroid and all its riches will be yours.
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.initial.1: All you need to do is hand me that radio.
~ You can choose to attack, or right-click the Orbital Radio on the Voidborn Leader. The choice is yours. ~
So be it. May this place be the death of you.
~ Having turned down the offer, you'll still need to find the radar and disable it! ~
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.givenradi: Give me a moment to trace their location.
I shall initiate the teleport soon.
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.vanguardS: Has the Voidborn radar been destroyed?
That radio was a very useful piece of equipment.
It has been a pleasure being your adversary.
Now it's time to end this.
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.endAstero: You're back in the voidborn asteroid base.
Hoping you made the right decision.
voidvanguards.voidborn.chest.title: Voidborn Storage
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.cosmos_ga: As you enter the portal, you feel your existance warping through space and time.
That familiar feeling of being warped fills your mind.
Some magical force is preventing you from entering the portal.
The existing voidborn around the portal prevent you from entering!
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.base.brea: Some magical force is preventing you from breaking blocks.
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.base.plac: Some magical force is preventing you from placing blocks.
voidvanguards.message.voidborn.base.rada: You flip the lever, ignoring every safety protocol. The radar sizzles as you force a hard shutdown.
The radar is broken and the lever is stuck.
item.voidvanguards.orbital_radio.lore: A high-tech radio that hums faintly.
item.voidvanguards.orbital_radio.descrip: Could this be used to contact the Vanguard?
item.voidvanguards.orbital_radio.spawned: Suddenly, a strange radio materializes in mid-air before you!
Suddenly, a strange radio materializes in mid-air behind you!
item.voidvanguards.orbital_radio.pickedu: As you pick up the radio, it starts vibrating. You're not entirely sure if you should try to answer it.
item.voidvanguards.orbital_radio.useUnab: You are unable to get a signal.
item.voidvanguards.orbital_transponder.l: A beacon that locks onto the Vanguard Station.
item.voidvanguards.orbital_transponder.a: You feel the item vibrate and hum!
item.voidvanguards.orbital_transponder.u: You successfully beam on to the Vanguard Station.
item.voidvanguards.orbital_transponder.l: You leave the station, and materialize back on the planet.
item.voidvanguards.orbital_transponder.u: You are unable to get a signal.
